component.name: krisCC
component.summary: Personal Kirigami control center for KrisOS and Fedora bootc

description.p: krisCC provides persistent KrisOS software management, operational repair tools, services and network controls, KrisOS updates, system/boot diagnostics, recovery and local backup/restore; Flatpak and container application management are delegated to dedicated tools.
Swiss Army control-center layout with operational repair, cleanup, service/network controls, firmware boot and hardware diagnostics; internal Podman management removed.
Minimal Flatpak integration through KDE Discover plus Podman, DNF5, rk preview/error and backup robustness fixes.
Image-safe Control Center updates, streamlined Dashboard/System tools, on-demand Flatpak details and contract cleanup.
Fail-closed backup recovery hardening, a rebalanced dashboard, quick system shortcuts and a constrained stable Control Center updater.
Latest-green ZIP repository export and simplified Flatpak remote contract.
Same validated 0.7 trial behavior with simplified X.Y.Z-only public versioning.
Structural hardening, bounded privileged execution, virtualized software lists, refreshed dashboard health state and consolidated control-center UX.

Structured KrisOS state backends, tightly scoped privileged maintenance, live CPU/RAM/temperature status, persistent personal command scripts, daily diagnostics, and a documented long-term compatibility architecture.
Finalized BootC staged-update handling, bounded long-running mutations, deterministic RPM search results, and hardened repository URL validation.

Final K1.0 control-center integration with persistent navigation, isolated page operations, completed BootC workflow, repository management, Flatpak and Podman refinements, and safer backup and recovery UX.
Minimal unified KrisOS system center, health and boot tools, backup restore, local history and expanded safe terminal bookmarks.
Kirigami UI, RPM and Flatpak management, Podman container tools, maintenance and personal backup snapshots.
